From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-discovery: lock TDX window + infra/data asks

Hi Sam + Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive (TDX) with our ML/infra folks.

Recap (high level):
- You want to validate model inference latency and cost for two main workloads: patient-summaries (avg seq len ~600 tokens) and chart-qa (avg seq len ~180 tokens).
- Primary success criteria: median p95 latency < 300ms for chart-qa in a 2-replica dedicated pool and <= 6x cost compared to your current baseline for batch scoring.
- Data & security: you indicated sample de-identified S3 export is available; Atlas prefers read-only access or a temporary role.

Proposed TDX (60–90 min) goals:
1) Walk through infra topology + data sample (10–15m)
2) Load-profile and latency/cost expectations (20–25m)
3) Live run: inference on sample dataset + perf knobs (25–35m)
4) Next steps / mutual action plan / SLA & procurement ramp (10m)

Available windows (PDT) — pick one and we’ll send invite (we can do 75m to fit everything):
- Tue June 1: 10:00–11:15
- Wed June 2: 13:30–14:45
- Thu June 3: 08:30–09:45

Preflight asks (so we can prep infra and owners):
- Confirm 2–3 attendees from Atlas (ML lead + infra or data eng preferred)
- Provide sample S3 path or a 5-row CSV with representative messages and schema (we can accept de-identified PHI)
- Indicate whether the run should target a Redwood-hosted demo env or your VPC (we support both; VPC will need a brief networking handoff)

I attached a one-page draft agenda and an initial mutual action plan (MAP) for planning.

If any of the slots don't work, tell us a couple windows that do and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Priya and I talked and a couple quick answers up front: we can provide a de-identified S3 export (we'll need to redact some fields) and Daniel Park (ML infra lead) should join.

For the windows you proposed, the earliest that works for Daniel is Wed June 2 at 13:30 PT. That slot looks best for our full team. Can you confirm Redwood can run the live inference in a sandbox that reads from our S3 (we'll provide temporary creds) rather than spinning up a full VPC for the demo? That would keep the first run lightweight.

Also — for the sample set, do you have a preferred format (Parquet vs CSV)? Parquet is easier for us, but we can do CSV if that helps.

Thanks — Sam
